generation_note: The first generation pass for Tetsu, Kenji, Phantom and Shizuku used a relative output_dir; those 4 files did NOT materialise on disk even though the tool returned success with snapshot IDs (Tetsu ckosoa, Kenji r99cvp, Phantom 6ib0pq, Shizuku xe1m07). They are NOT listed as outputs and were NOT used. All 9 deliverables below were regenerated with an absolute output_dir and verified on disk by ls + PIL (all 1120x2240) + eye-check. The media-generation-*.webp files in this folder are the provenance copies of the deliverables; the dojo-elite-*-battle-back-2026-10-26.webp files are byte copies of them.
method: Reference image first, then visible attributes only. No character name and no franchise name was put in any generation prompt. Each back was generated from its own battle-front webp as the reference image. Step-8 JSONs were used only as an attribute cross-check, not as a generation image. All 9 outputs were opened and eye-checked after generation: true back view, full body, cel style matching the existing battle sheets, plain light-grey background, no face, no face overlay, no baked ground shadow.
